name: Weekend Edition
tagline: Collects a week of saved reading into a paper you can actually print
description: Everything you bookmarked on X and every link you stashed during the week gets pulled together once it ends. The result is laid out like a small paper, with the pieces grouped into sections rather than left as a flat run of URLs, and it is formatted to come out cleanly on an A4 sheet.
author: Nathan
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
